name: Obsidian plugins
description: Runs Obsidian community plugins as they are: each one is listed with your plugins, with its own switch, options, commands, views and panels. They run with the app's full access, like in Obsidian.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: Obsidian plugins run here (obsidian-compat): what they draw isn't text; read the notes themselves.
